maria_sec: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the PrivEdge hardening checklist for next week's onprem validation. Main pillars: netpol tightening, KMS handshake tests, RBAC delta deploy, and an incident-runbook smoke test. Anyone see immediate blockers?

chris_infra: +1. For netpols we should confirm egress allowances for the keystore agent. Last time we accidentally blocked the HSM CA endpoint.

nina_ops: Reminder — audit logging needs to capture KMS decrypt attempts with caller identity. We had a blind spot in the last trial where the service account alias was missing in logs.

leon_devsec: Good catch. For RBAC I'm planning a scoped change: remove default cluster-admin binding from the staging jumpbox namespace and add a read-only role for ops to the keystore namespace. Will create the YAML shortly.

maria_sec: Leon — when you add the role, can you include explicit `namespace: keystore` and `aggregationRule: null` so we avoid implicit grants? Also add `rules` that log `get/patch/exec` with `resourceNames: ["keystore-agent"]` so it's narrow.

leon_devsec: Yep. Draft snippet:

```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-auditor
  namespace: keystore
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get","list"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```

chris_infra: Two quick netpol items: 1) allow DNS to the cluster-coredns svc only, 2) egress whitelist for KMS endpoints (HSM IPs). Example command: `kubectl apply -f netpol-allow-kms.yaml`.

nina_ops: For audit collection, we'll tag events with `redwood.env=privedge` and ship to the onprem SIEM. Sam — can you confirm retention policy for these logs?

sam_oncall: I'll confirm. Current plan is 90 days hot, 1 year cold. But for KMS-related auth failures we might want 1y hot. I'll raise with compliance.

maria_sec: Vulnerability triage: yesterday's CVE flagged the keystore agent image (glibc minor). We need an emergency patch cycle but keep it minimal risk. Suggest: build patched image, run smoke decrypts with local HSM simulator, then canary to a single AZ private pool.

leon_devsec: Agreed. Add automated smoke: `./tools/smoke_kms.sh --count 100 --verify` as part of the rollout pipeline. If >0.1% failures, auto-revert.

chris_infra: Ops note: when canarying, ensure netpols for the canary pod include the identical egress set. Otherwise we get false negatives.

maria_sec: Also add incident runbook step: if a KMS decrypt fails for >1% of requests for 5m, redirect traffic to hosted fallback model and open P1. Add a Slack notify channel `#privedge-incidents`.

nina_ops: I'll update the runbook. Can we include the exact query to surface decrypt failure spikes in the metrics: `sum(rate(kms_decrypt_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(kms_decrypt_requests[5m]))` > 0.01 triggers.

deploy-bot: schedule: privedge-canary-deploy started by chris_infra at 1721234700 — status: queued.

maria_sec: Great. Action items: leon -> post RBAC YAML, chris -> netpol whitelist file, nina -> runbook update, sam -> log retention confirmation. We'll sync tomorrow 10:00 PT before the canary. :thumbsup:
